proposed_task.name: meeting_local_voice_to_face_matching
proposed_task.question: Which candidate video shows the person who spoke in the audio reference?
proposed_task.audio_source: mixed headset audio only; never individual lapel/headset channel identity
proposed_task.video_source: four duration-matched closeup clips from a separate time in the same meeting
proposed_task.labels: manual speaker intervals joined with official camera/channel mapping
proposed_task.task_scope: within-meeting cross-modal association; not cross-recording identity recognition
